advise_catalyst: You get hardest on yourself when your strength has nothing to build. Give it something. Pick one venture this month and carry it to its first result. Plant one thing this week, a seed or a skill, and watch it grow.
advise_friction: Seek Metal, your own Body energy. Metal is what stays when the wanting stops, the rest under the effort. Let it hold what Wood pours out. You treat rest as time stolen from building. Drop one project you no longer believe in. Choose three things for this month and turn down the others.

advise_catalyst: You do your best work when someone is allowed to tell you no. Ask someone you respect to grade one piece of your work, and hear the score. Say your doubt out loud the next time a plan is agreed too fast.
advise_friction: Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth takes the blaze in and keeps the warmth, ground that does not catch. Let it hold what Fire burns. You answer to pressure faster than you recover from it. Stay with one hard feeling for ten minutes before you act on it. Tend one plant or one friendship with no goal attached.

advise_catalyst: Your judgment is only as good as the time you let it take. Bring one half-done job from last year to its end this month. Hold a big choice for seven days and see if it still stands.
advise_friction: Seek Wood, the Action energy. Wood draws on the ground it grows from and turns what it takes into something built. Let it spend what Earth stores. You stay with what you already know rather than put it to use. Send the rough draft before the clean one exists. Try a new method on a familiar problem.

advise_catalyst: You treat rest as something you earn after the work instead of the thing the work runs on. Cut one commitment this month that drains more than it gives. Decide your stopping time before the work begins, and stop there.
advise_friction: Seek Fire, the Order energy. Fire is heat with a deadline that gives your force a direction and a judge. Let it soften what Metal hardens. With no one above you, you answer only to yourself. Say your plan to a person who can refuse it. Share one unfinished piece of work with three people this month.

advise_catalyst: What you have to give runs short, and it counts for nothing until someone hears it. Tell someone one story with no lesson in it. Ask one person what they took from it, and listen to the end.
advise_friction: Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth is the ground under the water, the bank that stills it until it clears. Let it hold what Water pours. You let it all out as it comes, and nothing stays in long enough to settle. Keep one piece of news to yourself for a week. Hold to one plan for a whole month.
